description: Context boosting reaches only so far. A keyword lifts a weak value's score when it sits within a few words, and not beyond that. The same ambiguous number appears three times: beside its keyword, far from it, and with no keyword at all. Paired with weak-without-context.

slots.name: nearAccount
slots.label: bank_account
slots.note: Weak on its own; the word 'account' sits within the context window and should lift it over the threshold.

slots.name: farAccount
slots.label: bank_account
slots.note: The same shape, with the keyword pushed well outside the window. Whether this is detected is exactly what the window's width decides.
